how_to_read_this: One row per user-facing promise. A feature is only VERIFIED_LIVE when the live product path reaches it AND evidence shows it ran. Seeded 2026-09-10 with ONLY what was actually proven; everything not listed is NOT_YET_AUDITED by definition, which is the honest backlog rather than a silent assumption. Enforced by tools/feature-truth-lint.mjs.

labels.VERIFIED_REAL_LIVE: Proven with real production agency/client usage.
labels.LIVE_DEMO_VERIFIED: Full path proven end-to-end in the live environment with demo/test data. Pilot-ready when also regression-guarded, safe against unapproved sends, and the UI matches the engine.
labels.MECHANISM_PROVEN: The underlying worker/cron/send path has real evidence, but the full product promise is not proven.
labels.PARTIAL_UNPROVEN: Pieces exist; the full promise is not proven.
labels.EXISTS_BUT_NOT_WIRED: Built, possibly 'active', but no live caller reaches it.
labels.FALSE_UI_CLAIM: The UI says or implies something untrue. Must be fixed, never parked.
labels.NOT_LIVE_COMING_LATER: Intentionally not live; the UI says so.
labels.NOT_YET_AUDITED: Nobody has walked the eight questions. Never present as working. Backlog, not a CI failure.

features.product_impact: The core customer path works in demo conditions. The P1 would silently lose a lead's turn.
features.immediate_truth_fix: None — the UI does not overclaim; but it cannot distinguish 'Amanda answered' from 'Amanda never got the turn'.
features.permanent_product_fix: Fix the duplicate_ignored gate + add a reconciliation sweep (parking lot P1).

pilot_ready_rule: Pilot readiness does NOT require VERIFIED_REAL_LIVE — there is no real agency traffic yet. A feature is pilot-ready when it is at least LIVE_DEMO_VERIFIED, the full path is proven in the live environment with test/demo data, it is regression-guarded, it cannot send for real without approval, and the UI truth matches the engine.
closing_rule: Christian, 2026-09-11: a caption, warning or not-live label is an IMMEDIATE TRUTH FIX, never the permanent fix. An issue closes only when (A) the feature works end-to-end and is verified, (B) it is intentionally retired and the product promise removed, or (C) it is explicitly not part of AIVENA now — NOT_LIVE_COMING_LATER with an owner and a revisit status.
